title: Program labels for the search procedure
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, let $\mathrm{Lb}(K_0)$ be the inductive type of labels for the search procedure. Its labels represent setup and width operations, the first and second searches and their relaxation rounds, counting and iteration steps, the final scan and its accept or reject outcomes, copy-loop phases indexed by a copy site and a phase in $\{0,\ldots,6\}$, move phases indexed by $\{0,1,2\}$, shift phases indexed by one of three search stages and a step in $\{0,\ldots,8\}$, and memory-access phases indexed by a site and an access phase; the copy sites include an addition index in $\{0,\ldots,K_0-1\}$.
